update.releaseNotes:
v1.4.0 - Grand Concert plays itself, Borrow list scanning gets more reliable, and career-start safety gets tighter
- New: Grand Concert is automated end to end -- training, races, training events, the Lesson shop's song and technique buying, and all five concerts including the Grand finale, with the right stat caps and a preset for every trainee in the roster. Run queues, trainee rotation, and TP restore all work with it too. - New: an advanced, opt-in Build-Aware Launch mode that verifies the live Borrow list, deck, and launch screen before spending TP and refuses to start rather than guess when it cannot confirm the setup -- off by default, alongside an optional Windows companion app for last-resort Borrow-list scroll recovery. - Improved: Smart Borrow handles long Borrow lists more reliably -- a stalled scroll is no longer mistaken for the end of the list, the selected card is re-checked immediately before the tap, and recovery after the accessibility service restarts mid-scroll is sturdier. - Fixed: the bot now verifies Normal Career mode is selected before pressing the irreversible Start Career button, instead of trusting whichever tab the game last had open. - Fixed: settings search now reaches every settings page it points at, including Run Queue, Discord, and Scenario Overrides settings. - Fixed: skill tier data is restored after the community source restructured its page, and this release also includes the trainee-selection swipe, spark reroll chooser, and Grass Wonder (Saintly Jade Cleric) improvements.
